squad.attrShort.heading: Hea
squad.roles.captainHint: Lifts the team's performance while he's on the pitch. If he's left out, the vice-captain gives half the effect. An unhappy captain hurts the dressing room.
squad.roles.penaltyHint: Takes penalties in matches and goes first in shoot-outs.
squad.roles.setPieceHint: The better his crossing, the more headed chances you get, and he'll often assist headed goals.
squad.roles.note: If the chosen player isn't on the pitch, someone else takes over automatically for that match.

squad.toast.gkFixed: The goalkeeper slot can't be moved. Swap players instead.
squad.pick.moveHint: Tap an empty spot to move there (tap again to cancel)
squad.pick.note: The number on the right is his rating at {pos} (condition included). Tap to swap straight away; the replaced player drops to the reserves.
squad.pitch.emptyCell: Only players on the pitch can be moved to empty spots

squad.th.moodTip: Happiness with playing time (tap a player to talk)
squad.th.condTip: Condition: drops when playing, recovers each round
